jobs.title: Housing Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
JOB TITLE: Housing Program Coordinator
SUPERVISOR: WSAG Executive Director
RESPONSIBLE TO: WSAG Governing Board

GOAL:
In collaboration with the WSAG team, coordinate emergency housing through direct case management and outreach.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Computer literacy and ability to use a spreadsheet to track data such as daily phone calls, waitlists, room use, and timesheets
Answer company-assigned telephone during posted hours of operation
Monitor social media inquiries
Outreach and attendance to local organizations and events directly supporting unhoused and inadequately housed people in WSAG service area
Intake and placement of clients for both short and longer-term stays
Room check before and after a client is housed
Connect to resources using brochures and pamphlets 

Longer-term Clients (10+ days)

Comprehensive intake and needs assessment within 72 hours of enrollment (including MH screening)
Connect with Long Valley Health regarding support with recipients with behavioral health needs
Create and monitor individualized Stabilization Plan/s
Initiate Crisis and Safety Plans
Initiate daily check-ins with clients, and weekly in-person or virtual case management meetings
Manage housing search assistance
Perform landlord outreach and engagement
Data collection and administration of applications and submissions support
Rental history problem-solving
Coordination of move-in assistance
Referrals to County Behavioral Health and community providers
Warm handoffs to treatment providers
Coordination of appointments and follow-up
Screening for eligibility (CalWORKs, CalFresh, Medi-Cal, SSI/SSDI, General Assistance)
Application assistance

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

At least three years of direct experience with the unhoused population, housing, and at least one year of experience connecting people with resources such as NGOs and local governments. Degree or certification in Human Services or Behavioral Health preferred.
Pass background check and drug test
Ability to communicate effectively and clearly (both written and oral communication) 
Must be able to interact effectively with other employees in all levels of the organization as well as with the general public.

jobs.title: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
This is a full-time, hourly role at Food For Thought Outreach. This role will work in both Okaloosa and Walton Counties. https://www.foodforthoughtfl.org/careers

Qualified candidates should email their resume to us at support@fftfl.org

Overview

The Program Operations Coordinator provides continuity within our full scope of service year-round with their organizational knowledge and understanding of our standard operating procedures. Program Operations Leads must develop a strong understanding of the history, culture, and mission of the organization. In addition, a commitment to our organizational standards and best practices must be demonstrated consistently. A Program Operations Coordinator will be on-site with our volunteers in our pantry locations or out in the community, providing services at least 50% of the time. This position plays a critical role in the training and retention of our volunteer base. It is the responsibility of this role to educate our volunteers on our mission, programs, and opportunities to support the organization.

Skills & Qualifications

Highly adaptable
3+ years of experience working on a team or leading a team in person
Experience with critical thinking and problem-solving in a professional environment
Strong organizational skills and personal time management
Experience with Google Suite and willing to learn new software programs
Enjoy working with a team in a culture of high-performance expectations
Strong in-person and written communication skills. Comfortable talking with small groups of people.
Enjoy working with volunteers of all ages and small and large groups
Passion for our mission and commitment to the work required to deliver our program services.
Willingness to work in a variety of settings, including an office environment, pantry/warehouse, and in the field.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Holdings offers industry-leading wealth management platforms for independent wealth management professionals nationwide. Kestra is dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients.

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact.

Kestra Holdings is seeking a Program Manager to support our Sales & Servicing Platform, with a strong focus on Salesforce and related technologies. This role is highly visible and central to executing our enterprise Salesforce roadmap. You’ll partner closely with technology, compliance, and business leaders to translate strategy into delivery—ensuring programs are aligned, well governed, and driving measurable outcomes for advisors and internal teams.

This is an ideal opportunity for a program leader who thrives in complex environments, enjoys cross functional collaboration, and is passionate about delivering scalable, advisor‑centric platform solutions.

What You’ll Do:

Execute the Salesforce & MarTech Roadmap: Support the Head of Sales & Servicing Platform Strategy in executing a multi‑year Salesforce and Marketing technology roadmap. Translate strategic objectives into structured programs, milestones, and delivery plans.
Drive Cross‑Enterprise Alignment: Ensure initiatives are coordinated across Kestra Holdings’ lines of business and functional teams, resolving dependencies and aligning priorities to maximize enterprise impact and driving alignment between business objectives, product strategy, and technical execution.
Lead Program Governance & Collaboration: Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, requirements definition, and decision forums. Serve as a primary point of contact for business and executive stakeholders across technology, compliance, operations, and product teams.
Manage Platform & Vendor Relationships: Support platform evaluations, vendor onboarding and management, contract negotiations, and delivery oversight to ensure solutions meet business, technical, and regulatory requirements.
Ensure Operational Excellence: Oversee program planning, risk management, resourcing, and delivery tracking. Partners with technology and data teams on integration planning, data migrations, and release coordination while ensuring compliance and security considerations are addressed.
Communicate with Executives: Prepare executive-ready updates, dashboards, and decision materials. Provide clear visibility into progress, risks, and outcomes while proactively managing stakeholder expectations.
Change Management and Adoption: Support enablement efforts by helping define training, communication, and rollout strategies to drive adoption. Monitor adoption metrics and continuously optimize based on user feedback.

What You Bring:

5+ years of experience in program management, technology delivery, business architecture, or technology strategy—preferably within financial services, wealth management, or a regulated environment.
Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Technology, or a related field (MBA preferred)
Experience managing enterprise programs in the Salesforce ecosystem, including cross functional delivery and vendor‑led initiatives.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, and stakeholders simultaneously.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management‑ skills, including comfort working with senior and executive audiences.
Familiarity with advisor‑centric platforms such as CRM, client portals, workflow, compliance, trading, or billing systems.
Experience with collaboration and visualization tools such as Microsoft O365, JIRA, Confluence, Lucid Suite, and Figma.
Proven ability to translate strategy into execution, manage ambiguity, and drive outcomes.
Collaborative, adaptable, detail oriented, and motivated by delivering scalable, high‑impact solutions.

Internal Application Policy:

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Kestra Values:

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

Explore Life at Kestra

Kestra Holdings Website: https://www.kestrafinancial.com/

Careers Portal: https://jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-US/kestra/KESTRACAREERSITE

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kestra-financial

Apply Today

Lead with purpose. Apply now and help shape the future of Kestra.

Discipline: RN

Start Date: 08/24/2026

Duration: 13 weeks

40 hours per week

We prioritize flexibility, consistent pay, and access to comprehensive benefits so clinicians can focus on delivering exceptional patient care.
